rules.accepted_credit_types: Preapproved: programs sponsored/approved by ASWB, NASW, NABSW, NACSW, Clinical Social Work Association; sponsored by APA, ACA, NBCC, American Psychiatric Association, CSWE-accredited Kentucky social work programs; related academic courses (1 credit = 15 h). Other programs need board approval; Kentucky ethics and supervision courses always need board approval
rules.audit_note: Licensees list CE hours at renewal; up to 15% audited each calendar year; keep documentation 1 year after last renewal.

topics.who: Board-approved course on the Kentucky Code of Ethical Conduct (201 KAR 23:080)
Board-approved training in suicide assessment, treatment and management (KRS 210.366), every 6 years
3-hour course on domestic violence and elder abuse, neglect and exploitation in the 3-year period after initial licensure
Part of the same 3-hour DV/elder abuse course after initial licensure
Recognition and prevention of pediatric abusive head trauma, once every 6 years
LCSW board-approved supervisors: board-approved clinical supervision course

rules.notes: 3-year renewal period; CE in person or technology-mediated. Hour = 50 minutes. Board meeting attendance up to 6 h. Board site bsw.ky.gov returned 403 to our checker.
rules.rule_quote: (1) Each certified social worker and licensed clinical social worker shall complete a minimum of thirty (30) continuing education hours during the three (3) year period for renewal…
